not_a_defect: These are class-conditional ROW samplers built for class balancing, and they do that job. This is a statement about what they cannot be REUSED for, not a fault. A row sampler cannot produce a price path, and the policy under test is path-dependent: stops, grace windows, holding limits and take-profit all depend on the order bars arrive in.
scorecard_note: FR-016: TabDDPM, WGAN and CTAB-GAN+ were rebuilt 2026-09-10 and docs/GAN_SCORECARD.md predates that. Any figure quoted from the scorecard must be re-verified against current code or labelled historical with its date. This census reads current code and quotes no scorecard figure.
consequence: No learned generator is carried (clarification Q3). The single generator is a stationary block bootstrap over real panels.
